definitions.explanation: The period in which a mother is breastfeeding her infant. Used on medicine labels, food packaging, and in medical contexts to indicate precautions for nursing mothers.

examples.japanese: {授乳中|じゅにゅうちゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{飲酒|いんしゅ}→飲酒：08635_inshu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}けて→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please avoid drinking alcohol while breastfeeding.

examples.japanese: {授乳中|じゅにゅうちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{服用|ふくよう}→服用：15267_fukuyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}して→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please consult a doctor about taking medicine while breastfeeding.

examples.japanese: {授乳中|じゅにゅうちゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧よい⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心|こころ}がける→心がける：10015_kokorogakeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: During breastfeeding, it is important to be mindful of eating a nutritionally balanced diet.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{授乳|じゅにゅう}→授乳：14937_junyuu⟧ (breastfeeding; nursing) + ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (during; in the middle of). The base word ⟦{授乳|じゅにゅう}→授乳：14937_junyuu⟧ means the act of nursing or breastfeeding.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {授乳中|じゅにゅうちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧: nursing mothers
- {授乳中|じゅにゅうちゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{禁忌|きんき}: contraindicated during breastfeeding (label warning)
- {授乳中|じゅにゅうちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧: precautions during breastfeeding

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {妊娠中|にんしんちゅう}: during pregnancy — often appears alongside 授乳中 in warnings
- {母乳育児|ぼにゅういくじ}: breastfeeding as a childcare practice
